name: rbi_get_gsec_yield
description:
Indian Government Securities (G-Sec) yields in percent for a 1, 5, 10 or 30 year maturity, from the Reserve Bank of India's DBIE endpoint (rbi.org.in/Scripts/api/dbie, no API key).
Returns: series_code, label, description, unit, frequency, observation_count and observations (date, value) as the endpoint orders them.
Inputs (* required): bond_term* (1y, 5y, 10y, 30y; schema default 10y); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, passed through as fromDate and toDate); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
For policy rates use rbi_get_policy_rate.
Example: {"bond_term": "10y", "recent_periods": 20}
